title: Test & Quality System — Where It Stands
thesis: Softanza has no test framework as a module; it has a test-and-quality discipline spread across the estate, whose signature is that a test is a readable specification and a green checkmark is never enough. 455 narrated guards read as Given/When/Then specs, correctness is proven against independent numpy/LAPACK oracles and byte-parity ground truth, and an adversarial gate of 1,416 assertions carries 58 negative controls. Where it is thin: property/mutation is engine-only, there is no coverage instrumentation and no CI, and the classic suites carry a fidelity backlog.

lanes.note: _narrated.ring gives a Given/When/Then DSL across 455 *_narrated.ring guards and 10,000+ assertions; the per-file chk() idiom is copy-pasted, not imported
_gen_numpy_reference.py generates _numpy_reference.ring / _numpy_fft_reference.ring (eigenvalues, SVD, det, Cholesky); BERT forward matches numpy to 1.64e-7
gg_adversarial.ring (23,481 lines, 1,416 assertions): every assertion exists because a defect survived a green suite; 58 negative siblings, 82 discharges()
stzRuleReport collects findings in one shape from 13 rule domains with IsSound(); 14 code rules + the knob gate; signable stzPredicateSet; not wired to any CI
plot.zig holds 29 byte-parity tests against pre-port ground truth; stzLLMFunction.AddGolden/RunGoldens; #--> markers; snapshots pin current, not correct
Five UBSan-trap fuzzers (http, tls/X.509, pcre2 300k rounds, sqlite, utf8) via zig build fuzz; engine-only, random-round not coverage-guided, not continuous
D0-D6 cluster guards spawn genuine OS processes via uv_spawn, exchange STZM frames, perform real kills; a focused set, not a general framework
Inline test blocks in 151 of 371 engine .zig files, run by the build's test step; broad but not universal, and unmeasured
Million-scale guards (1M-item IntSeq ~7 ms vs >60 s; 999_*_millions suites) and multilingual stress (Arabic/CJK/emoji); timed guards are load-sensitive
Narrated guards double as specs and 135 prose narrations explain the same features; the guard <-> narration link is convention, not enforced
Three prop_*.zig files (crypto with mutation-kill, http, ratebucket); engine-only, no Ring-side property testing, no generator/shrinking, no mutation framework
Coverage is by assertion count; bespoke Python runners; no line/branch coverage, no CI config (.github absent), classic #--> suites ~41-60% green, 1,312 #ERR

standouts: A test is a readable specification: 455 narrated Given/When/Then guards
Correctness proven against independent numpy/LAPACK oracles, not self-captured snapshots
An adversarial gate of 1,416 assertions each born from an escaped defect, with 58 negative controls
One rule gate collecting code, security, agent and diagram findings in a single shape
gaps: A standard CI pipeline running the rule gate on every push
Coverage instrumentation (line/branch) for the engine and guards
Ring-side property testing and a shipped assertion module
Close the fidelity-grind backlog (1,312 #ERR in the classic suites)
dated: Read from the source on 2026-09-17, from a read-only main worktree -- base/test/_narrated.ring (455 guards), base/meta/promises.py (~8,500 #--> markers), engine test blocks (151/371 files), fuzzers and props, _gen_numpy_reference.py, plot.zig, stzRuleReport + stzPredicateSet, health in base/test/_STATUS.md / _FINDINGS.md
